comments.author: takenmake
comments.body_html: No, your inventory is reverted back to what it was before the raid. So if you put something in your secure container before the raid and die, it’ll still be there. However, if you pick up something during the raid and die, it won’t.

comments.author: takenmake
comments.body_html:
To be fair insurance isn’t completely moot since you can still commit insurance fraud by dropping old gear in raid to replace it with better gear and having a chance to get it back, however yeah it’s still not as useful.

But getting back to the main point, essentially you’re just wanting an option to only reset quest progress to pre-raid but keep everything else the same as vanilla? It’s likely possible, but it’s not something I’ll promise since that kind of defeats most of the purpose of the mod, which is to make the experience better for a single-player casual playstyle.

comments.author: ThreeJackdaws
comments.body_html:
It’s not a case of wanting to take away the purpose of what the mod is, I just feel it would be good added extra to still be forced to use other gear if you fall in raid. As it stands, when you upgrade/find better gear, you literally have no use for other vests, weapons or anything, unless you just fancy running another setup. And being as there is no third person, there’s no reason to change gear just for cosmetics as we can’t see it anyway, so they are just taking up space.

Like I say, it would be nice if we can just flick something like that on and off if we so choose

comments.author: Daemris
comments.body_html:
Update: It is possible. GPT 5.6-High made a version of this mod with a toggle.

I would have added it as an add-on, but this type of add-on is explicitly prohibited. You would need to audit the code, I do not know C#.

Testing:

  • Toggle OFF works: saves normally on death (PMC and Scav)
  • Toggle ON works: does NOT save on death (PMC and Scav). It retains the strange “zero to hero” scav behavior.

It functions in an environment with 79 client mods and 44 server mods. The toggle has not been tested in a Fika multiplayer raid yet, but I see no reason why it would not work so far.

Let me know if you would like the source, or for me to make a fork on GitHub or something.

comments.author: Daemris
comments.body_html:
The reason I wanted this feature is because my friend complained that with an older version of this mod he wouldn’t generate new scavs. It made him sad to run into raids without ammo or whatever. To be honest I’m not even 100% sure if this behavior is still present in the base mod, but I assume so since it’s present in the generated one.

Our “testing” hasn’t covered every case — namely how the mod behaves if two clients differ in whether the mod is enabled — but I expect that to work. The client regularly notifies the server that NSOD is enabled when it is enabled (architectural decision), it keeps track per client so far. I just haven’t tested it in the same raid.

Unfortunately I’m not sure if the base version worked or not in our case. I think my friend made the complaint and then I altered the mod before I tested the regular version. But I do know my version works.

There is only one issue (if you consider it an issue), and that too could be made into a toggle: It keeps your XP. When you die, it leaves your inventory and character as they were, but XP is properly attributed after death.

I will make a fork soon™, I was 100% not involved in this process at all aside from the prompt before this message. There is no repository or anything at this time, I built this and put it in my game. If you want to examine it earlier, that link is the source. I only had to point dotnet at some dependencies to get it to build.

comments.author: takenmake
comments.body_html:
In terms of the initial issue your friend had, it sounds a bit like a bug that was reported a while ago where the mod would apply to scavs too, however I thought patched that back in SPT 3.11 so I would need more information on how to reproduce this new bug.

For the rest, I assume you guys are testing on Fika? If so, the issue with XP wouldn’t surprise me. All I would say is that issues with Fika are expected, since the mod was not written for it. If it works to some degree that’s great, but at this point unless I release official support for it I won’t investigate Fika-related bugs. If you can reproduce issues out of Fika though, then do let me know because that is more immediate priority.
